# S6.1a — the evolution pipeline as an instrument-grade Lab recipe (§05h; R-2.9.5 · R-2.10.3⁴ · R-2.1.6⁴ · R-2.9.4⁴ · R-2.12.2⁴ · R-2.11.2⁴ · R-2.6.1⁴)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s5.8` (PR #90) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands Stage 6a's governed-evolution slice — the human-proposed
`HirDiff` pipeline as a Lab recipe — behind GATE-G3's released
preconditions.

**`hh-evolution` (new crate).** The `EvolutionCampaign` driver runs a
single `run_kind = experiment` campaign run and folds every decision
from the durable prefix: `measurement.evolution.campaign.*` +
`candidate.transitioned{from,to,stage}` rows, a closed S0–S10 state
machine, and a typed refusal table where every gate refusal lands a
`rejected{stage, code}` row before returning. Records-in/records-out —
the pipeline evaluates no task itself; the experiment engine is the
sole evaluation substrate (ADR-0320 D1/D2).

**The gates.** S1 validates the canonical diff (apply + invert +
byte-identical base restore + schema), refuses self-modification /
excluded / must-code targets, dedupes by content-derived
`candidate_id`. S2 binds a falsifiable hypothesis (`Origin::Evolution
{candidate_id, hypothesis_ref}` minted). S3 screens on targeted
counterexamples (judge-only refused, replicate floor, flip-share
floor, no held-out labels). S4 gates on M3 `matched_total` against a
registered, campaign-bound spec — stage-kind admission is enforced
(`StageKindMismatch`: eval stages take `comparative`/`equivalence`,
S10 takes `is_retirement()`). S5 requires `artifact_benefit` on a
`full_set` held-out comparison whose interval excludes 0, retention
clean, vetoes clean. S6 requires a measured held-out transfer row and
proven compatibility. S7 re-classifies the stored diff — no policy
widening, `subprocess_confined` placement only, declared interfaces,
dynamic veto table clean. S8 seals on the 7-item
`EvolutionAcceptanceReport` + `human`/`definition`-authority
endorsement (`SealRefused{not_human}`/`{not_definition}` — G3-1's
spellings). S9 is shadow-canary only (`split` is noncommittable;
abort/veto lands durable `reverted` — the sealed-ancestor restore is
the caller's `apply(base, invert(diff))`). S10: expiry triggers,
revalidate/reactivate, and `retire` on a human-sealed removal test
inside `retention_margin_ppm` — inconclusive revalidates, never
silently retires. Publication is confined to `exp/<campaign_id>/`
(AC-R-2.12.2-14).

**Cross-crate.** `hh-ledger` registers the campaign/candidate classes
and graduates `evolution_link` out of `DEFERRED_OBLIGATIONS` (the
hypothesized transition must carry `hypothesis_ref` + non-empty
`evidence_refs[]`). `hh-lab` gains `ExperimentKind::RetirementBatch`
(R-2.10.3⁴). `hh-gateway` executes `RoutingPolicyKind::Learned` only
on the matched evidence chain (AC-R-2.3.2-14). `hh-context` gates
evolution-origin memory promotion on a human reviewer + validator
endorsement, minting `context.memory.promotion_refused` and mapping
`PromotionRefused` through the ABI (AC-R-2.4.5-9). `hh-embed` exposes
`lab.evolution.*` (24 ops, experimental + `serves_measurement`,
schema-declared regardless of tier — a `tier-c4`-absent build answers
`Unsupported{by: "tier-c4"}`); `hh-web` renders `v6_evolution` as a
pure projection of `lab.evolution.view`.

## Decisions

**ADR-0320** — records-in/records-out engine (D1); closed durable
state machine (D2); `evolution_link` on hypothesized transitions (D3);
`RetirementBatch` in the removal-test gate set (D4); stage-kind
admission (D5); C4 removable slice (D6); learned-policy evidence chain
(D7); shadow-only canary + caller-side invert-restore (D8);
human-review promotion gate (D9).
